result.reason: The skill acquires and outputs full desktop screenshots and application text, material that can reasonably contain personal information. These are implemented content-acquisition operations; the artifacts do not establish what personal information is present at runtime.

evidence.quote:
try:
    # Take screenshot
    screenshot = pyautogui.screenshot()
    
    # Convert to base64
    buffered = io.BytesIO()
    screenshot.save(buffered, format="PNG")
    img_base64 = base64.b64encode(buffered.getvalue()).decode()
    
    # Output just the base64 (no prefix)
    print(img_base64)
